name: hud_ui_panel_set_clip
description: HudUiPanel::SetClip updates the blit source, optionally copies a clip rectangle, and invalidates through the panel vtable.
known_limits: No VC byte target covers 0x4bcd40 yet; tier S remains open for a later HUD panel source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4bcd40 validates storing bltSourceOrNull at offset 0x1c, copying rectOrNull into clipRect at offset 0x20 only when non-null, and always dispatching invalidate through vtable slot 8 (+0x20).
Binary Ninja data references validate 0x4bcd40 as the slot-6 SetClip implementation used by panel-derived vtables, including the transition text panel table at 0x4cd388+0x18.
The native panel SetClip smoke verifies the g_HudUiPanel_FTable slot-6 mapping, blit-source update, non-null rect copy, null-rect preservation, and invalidation through the panel table.
